question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Accomodate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Accommodate"** means to provide with a place to live or to be stored in. It refers to adjusting actions in consideration of others. (समायोजित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The hotel was eager to accommodate the needs of its diverse guests.
 
 
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in the options is **"Accomodate"** which is a common misspelling of the correct term **"Accommodate"**. The correct spelling contains double 'm'. (समायोजित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **It's important to correctly spell "Accommodate" in professional communications to avoid misunderstandings.
 
 
 
• Hence, the misspelled word is **'Accomodate'**, which should be spelled as **'Accommodate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Accomodate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Acknowledgement **(स्वीकृति): Acceptance of the truth or existence of something.

 
 
• **Example:** She nodded in acknowledgement of the greeting.
 
 
 
• **Address **(पता): The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated.
 
 
• **Example: **Please ensure your address is up-to-date in our records.
 
 
 
• **Acquire** (प्राप्त करना): To buy or obtain an object or asset for oneself.
 
 
• **Example:** The museum acquired a new piece for its ancient artifacts collection.
 
 

40:Tc63,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
